title: Production Fire Drill
intro: Real incidents don't stay inside one tool's boundary. This path chains four separate production fires across the stack — a host-level failure, a network problem, a Kubernetes crash loop, and a confusing alert — back to back, the way an actual on-call shift bounces between layers.
resolution: Four different incidents, four different layers of the stack — a systemd service that wouldn't start, a network path that was silently dropping packets, a Kubernetes pod stuck crash-looping, and an alert that fired without enough context to act on. Real on-call work jumps between all of these in a single shift, and the actual skill isn't memorizing any one tool's commands — it's recognizing which layer a symptom is actually coming from before you start debugging the wrong one.
